definitions.gloss: empty can; used beverage or food can
definitions.explanation: A can that has been emptied of its contents. Commonly encountered in the context of recycling and litter.

examples.english: To pick up an empty can.

examples.japanese: {空|あ}き{缶|かん}は{潰|つぶ}してからリサイクルに{出|だ}す。
examples.english: Crush empty cans before putting them out for recycling.

examples.japanese: {道|みち}に{空|あ}き{缶|かん}がたくさん{落|お}ちていて{残念|ざんねん}だった。
examples.english: It was unfortunate that there were so many empty cans littering the road.

notes:
A compound of {空|あ}き (empty) + {缶|かん} (can). Very commonly encountered in signs about recycling and waste separation in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {空|あ}き{缶|かん}を{潰|つぶ}す: to crush an empty can
- {空|あ}き{缶|かん}を{捨|す}てる: to throw away an empty can
- {空|あ}き{缶|かん}{回収|かいしゅう}: empty can collection
- {空|あ}き{缶|かん}ポイ{捨|す}て: littering with empty cans

RELATED WORDS:
- {空|あ}き{瓶|びん}: empty bottle
- {空|あ}き{箱|はこ}: empty box
- {缶|かん}: can — the base word; {缶詰|かんづめ} (canned food), {缶|かん}ジュース (canned juice)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan has strict waste separation rules. {空|あ}き{缶|かん} is one of the standard recycling categories, alongside {空|あ}き{瓶|びん} (bottles) and ペットボトル (PET bottles).
